title: Cardiovascular Events in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Patients Initiating Olodaterol or Other Long-acting beta2 Agonists
brief_summary: Examine the risk of cardiovascular events (cardiac arrhythmia or myocardial ischemia) or all-cause mortality in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) patients who are new users of Olodaterol or other LABAs available for the treatment of COPD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* COPD diagnosis
* aged 40 years or older (to minimise the likelihood of including individuals who have asthma only)
* New user of olodaterol or a new user of indacaterol, salmeterol, or formoterol (not in fixed-dose combination with an inhaled corticosteroid) and have no dispensing of any LABA in the 6 months before the index date
* at least 1 year of enrolment in the electronic database before their first LABA dispensing (defined as the index LABA)
* Complete data on sex

Exclusion criteria:

none
